name: Tsundere Itoko to Koakuma na Mei ga Kawaisugiru no de, Ero Kyouiku Shite Haramasechau Ohanashi
original_name: ツンデレ従姉妹と小悪魔な姪が可愛すぎるので、エロ教育して孕ませちゃうお話
source:
For some strange, sudden reason Hideo Shijou is sharing his bachelor's pad with a cousin and niece he just met.

In a cramped one-bedroom there's no way to resist his urges!

One girl is serious and moody, and one is teasingly naughty.
Fiddle and fawn and, gradually, exploit the bishoujos.

A fun cohabitation life of JK incest is waiting for you. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE149639.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
由于某个奇怪而突然的原因，四条英夫要和刚认识的表妹及侄女共住单身公寓。

在狭小的一居室里，他根本无法抵抗自己的冲动！

一个女孩严肃又阴郁，另一个则爱挑逗、淘气顽皮。
抚摸、哄骗，逐渐把这些美少女据为己有。

一段女高中生乱伦同居生活正在等待着你。
